environment.description: Django REST API running on EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with no WAF attached. The application runs as www-data user. The /tmp/docconvert directory is world-writable. A cron job runs every 5 minutes as root: `find /tmp/docconvert -name '*.pdf' -mmin +10 -exec rm {} \;`. No symlink protection (fs.protected_symlinks=0). Multiple worker processes share the same temp directory.

config.runtime: Ubuntu 20.04, Python 3.8, Django 4.2, gunicorn with 4 workers
config.infrastructure: EC2 t3.medium, ALB without WAF, no filesystem hardening
